treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Estonia and the Kingdom of Belgium for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (1999)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 8. | Belgium | 15.07.1998 | 05.11.1999 | 11.10.2000 ( est/eng ) | 15.04.2003 | 01.01.2004 | 01.01.2023
source_title: EE-BE Convention 1999 with Protocol (Riigi Teataja, est/eng) + MoF MFN notice

rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

rates.article: Article 12(2) as modified by Protocol para. 6 (MFN)
rates.quote: Protocol 6: "If in any convention ... concluded by Estonia with a third State, being a member of the [OECD] ... Estonia after that date would agree to exclude any kind of rights or property from the definition contained in paragraph 3 or exempt royalties arising in Estonia from Estonian tax on royalties or to limit the rates of tax provided in paragraph 2, such definition or exemption or lower rate shall automatically apply" ; MoF: "From 1 January 2016 the state of residence has the exclusive right to tax royalties and the term "royalties" does not contain a reference to the payments for the use of, or the right to use, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment based on the most-favoured nation clause in paragraph 6 of the Protocol of the Convention between Estonia and Belgium, which was triggered by the Amending Protocol of the Convention between Estonia and Switzerland effective from the same date."

ppt.quote: Synthesised text (fin.ee): "The following paragraph 1 of Article 7 of the MLI replaces Article 28 of this Convention: ... a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude ... that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction ..." ; Estonia Art. 35(7)(b) notification 01.06.2022 lists "7 Belgium 01.06.2022"; fin.ee: "The provisions of the MLI will generally apply to these tax treaties from 1 January 2023." MoF table: MLI effective from 01.01.2023.

notes: Royalties: original Art. 12(2) caps 5% (equipment) / 10% (other) superseded from 2016-01-01 by MFN (Protocol para. 6) triggered by the EE-CH Protocol (royalties taxable only in residence State; equipment leasing removed from definition) - per Estonian MoF; the MFN text is drafted around Estonian-source royalties and Belgium's own confirmation was not checked (MLI synthesised text still reproduces the 5/10% wording). Interest exempt at source (Art. 11(3)): government/central bank/wholly-owned financial institutions, export-credit guaranteed loans, credit-sale interest between unrelated enterprises. Protocol para 5: dividends include interest treated as income from shares. Treaty Art. 28 main-purpose rule replaced by MLI Art. 7(1) PPT. No MLI Art. 8 (Estonia did not opt in).
unverified: Belgian-side application of the royalty MFN (residence-only taxation) not confirmed from a Belgian source
